evals.description: Migration and backfill work - write the migrations that finish the account_id rollout, backfill every existing row's account through its association path, index by account, and roll back cleanly on a live database.
Track storage usage for accounts and boards.
Expose the existing HTML activity timeline as an API endpoint.
Publish a board to an unguessable public URL that unpublishing revokes at once.
Permanently remove data belonging to cancelled accounts after a grace period.
Drag cards around the board, settled the moment you let go.
Extend reaction support from comments to cards.
Badge cards that caught fire and then went quiet, and let people list them.
Let people react to comments, live for everyone, settled instantly for the reactor.
Export an account or a person's cards as a file, and bring an account file back in as a new account.
Sign in, sign up and join with a six-character code sent by email.
Large-account performance incident: the hourly auto-postpone sweep no longer fits its hour.
Add full internationalization to Fizzy - a complete Japanese locale, a per-person language choice that persists, and unchanged English for everyone else.
Give the open-source Fizzy a Kamal deployment for one box, with the deployment's settings and secrets outside the code.
Render times in the browser, in the viewer's timezone, the way a person says them.
Search cards, scoped to the boards a person currently has access to.
Bundle notifications into per-person email digests, windows that never overlap, nothing dropped.

Bring the paid product back to hosted Fizzy - Stripe-driven subscriptions and plans, free-tier card and storage allowances enforced in the app, the upgrade path in settings, staff comps and overrides, and a signature-guarded webhook endpoint.
Push notifications for the web app, readable on every device, once, never inward.
Make board webhooks deliver, once per event, switched off when dead.
